steady_speed.how: median planar speed over the steady window (after the ramp, before release)

accel_t90.how: time from the first non-zero speed sample to the first sample at >=90% of steady_speed

decel_t10.how: time from key release to the first sample at <=10% of steady_speed

turn_rate.how: median d(heading)/dt over the steady window, unwrapped across the 0/360 seam

jump_apex.how: max z minus z at launch

jump_airtime.how: launch to the first grounded sample after apex

jump_distance.how: planar distance travelled between launch and land

cast_lock_ms.how: from cast start to the first sample where movement input is honoured again

cast_speed_during.how: median planar speed while the cast window is active
